title: Public notice board truth ladder
summary: Separates confirmed instructions, verified local facts, unverified reports, and rumors.
content: Public notice board truth ladder is a practical offline routine for public information. Divide the board into official instructions, verified local facts, unverified reports, and questions needing checks. Every item needs date, time, source, and person who posted it. Remove or correct old items instead of letting stale information guide decisions. Do not post private medical, family, or conflict details unless safety requires it. Use simple Greek/English when mixed groups or visitors are present.
